risk_note: Payout read-only alert, RV2 by path (payout application, platform metrics, the fund alert rules), no money effect: no voucher, no balance change, no external write. The worker exports per app couli_withdrawals_w6_today, couli_withdrawals_w5w6_today (the +08:00 day, by transition time withdrawals.updated_at, D10-1186) and couli_withdrawals_w6_streak (D10-1203: W5 / W6 ordered by (updated_at, id), runs of W6 cut at each W5, the longest run whose last W6 is within (now - 24h, now], counted whole); W8, W9, W10 and W11 neither count nor break (D10-1170). couli-fund.yaml gets CouliWithdrawalFailRatioHigh (W6 / (W5 + W6) > 2 % with at least 20) and CouliWithdrawalFailStreak (>= 3), fund: 'true', and the outdated W6 TODO goes (BR-WDR-24 first two items, D10-1157). Read through payout's read-only port at scrape time, cached like the water gauges; a failed read fails the scrape. Rebased onto main after the reviews: the conflicts in entry.ts, metrics/index.ts, metrics/registry.ts, couli-fund.yaml and the two frozen spec files were B2-02v's credit-postcheck gauge added next to this one, both kept. The tie order of equal updated_at (id ascending) is implemented but not pinned by a rule test: tightening task B2-09zk (FU-B209ZJ-TIE-ORDER, ledger #3094) follows this PR.
